finding_status.notes: fetchData aborts the prior GET via AbortController, resets popup/pending/placeholders at start, and ignores aborted responses. Slug-change tests cover overlay and reset.
Error catch no longer setLoading(false); WorkflowForm mounts only when template != null; templateKey increments on success. Failure test asserts the form is absent.
New test seeds history.stack with two entries, clicks Cancel, and expects goBackWorkflows rather than workflows-all.
Apply-merge test now asserts form-yaml contains 'id: start', which the GET yaml 'states: []' cannot satisfy.
Popup awaits onSubmit, disables Apply via submittingRef, and parent generation ignores late materialize after Cancel. Both paths have tests.
